scope: Directory-local rule applies only to repositories/cca-conformance/tools/mo1307-phase3c and descendants. It cannot change production-package or docs attributes.

assessment.text: -text prevents Git line-ending conversion so executed engineering harness bytes remain reproducible in Git blobs.
assessment.whitespace: blank-at-eol and blank-at-eof explicitly retain trailing-space and excess terminal-blank-line checks; space-before-tab remains enabled. cr-at-eol recognizes CR as part of a CRLF terminator. Spaces or tabs before that terminator remain subject to blank-at-eol; the rule does not disable trailing-space checks.
assessment.limits: This preserves the named default Git whitespace checks and permits CRLF terminators. It is not a waiver for trailing spaces, arbitrary whitespace errors, source changes or byte-identity mismatch. The parent must still pass final staged diff and exact Git-blob byte checks.

observedEffectiveAttributes.productionRuntime: Separate scope unchanged: text unset; whitespace trailing-space,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol

conclusion: No new production security concern. Refinement is confined to engineering text-byte preservation and CRLF recognition; trailing-space checks remain enabled. No prior review was rewritten.
